lines.text: Many learners say: My sister is bigger than me.
Better: My sister is older than me.
Use older for age, not bigger.
Older! My brother is two years older than me.

data.wrong: My sister is bigger than me.
data.right: My sister is older than me.
data.why: Use older for age, not bigger.

quiz.stem: My brother is two years ___ than me.

native.tip: نقول «أختي أكبر مني»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول older للعمر: “My sister is older than me.” وليس “My sister is bigger than me.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “My sister is bigger than me.” 😅 نقول «أختي أكبر مني»، أما في الإنجليزية فنقول older للعمر، فالجملة الصحيحة “My sister is older than me.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “older” — للعمر نقول older. قلها بصوت عالٍ ثم اكتب جملة من عندك: {link}

en.tip: In Arabic we say «أختي أكبر مني», but in English we say older for age: “My sister is older than me.” not “My sister is bigger than me.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “My sister is bigger than me.” 😅 In Arabic we say «أختي أكبر مني», but in English we say older for age, so the right sentence is “My sister is older than me.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
